scope: Preserve DXF $MEASUREMENT source presence/value independently from $INSUNITS and verify ASCII/binary wire output, public parseback, unchanged following geometry, and same-profile replay.

localFinding.evidence: The original writer derived $MEASUREMENT from $INSUNITS and synthesized $MEASUREMENT=1 when both source variables were absent. Generated controls exposed that behavior; after the change, absence stays absent and explicit values survive independently.
localFinding.disposition: Fixed within the existing 7BJ.4 presence-policy owner; no new finding or subplan added.

implementation.policy: Emit $MEASUREMENT only when an integer source value is present, retaining explicit 0 or 1 regardless of $INSUNITS. Do not synthesize a value from units or rescale coordinates. This is a local DXF serialization policy, not consumer default qualification.
